title: nf-core/scdownstream pipeline - params.analysis_plan schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.analysis_plan

integration.description: Integration method name, or empty to match all integrations

subset.description: Clustering subset (global or a label value), or empty to match all subsets

resolution.description: Leiden resolution, or empty to match all resolutions

analyses.errorMessage: Analyses must be a comma-separated list of paga, liana, de, and/or cytetype
analyses.description: Downstream analyses to run for matching clusterings, or empty to run all analyses

de_methods.errorMessage: de_methods must be a comma-separated list of wilcoxon, t-test, t-test_overestim_var, logreg, pydeseq2, edgepython, and/or edgepython_sc
de_methods.description: Differential expression engines for matching clusterings, or empty to use the global --de_methods default
